name: MLLM-Bench
description: MLLM-Bench is a benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal large language models (MLLMs) using per-sample criteria with a potent MLLM as the judge. It covers six comprehensive cognitive levels and addresses the challenge of evaluating open-ended and subjective multimodal tasks by leveraging pairwise comparisons and achieving high agreement with human evaluation.
reputation: Includes an online leaderboard and shows 88.02% agreement with human evaluation, indicating promising adoption.
notes: Evaluates MLLMs with per-sample criteria using a strong MLLM as judge; addresses subjective and creative multimodal tasks.
